options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_host
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center hostname.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_port
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center port.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: family
options.description: Family query parameter. List of familiesRouters, Switches and Hubs, AP.

options.name: faultyDeviceName
options.description: FaultyDeviceName query parameter. Faulty Device Name.

options.name: faultyDevicePlatform
options.description: FaultyDevicePlatform query parameter. Faulty Device Platform.

options.name: faultyDeviceSerialNumber
options.description: FaultyDeviceSerialNumber query parameter. Faulty Device Serial Number.

options.name: headers
options.description: Additional headers.

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit query parameter. The number of records to show for this page.

options.name: offset
options.description: Offset query parameter. The first record to show for this page; the first record is numbered 1.

options.name: replacementDevicePlatform
options.description: ReplacementDevicePlatform query parameter. Replacement Device Platform.

options.name: replacementDeviceSerialNumber
options.description: ReplacementDeviceSerialNumber query parameter. Replacement Device Serial Number.

options.name: replacementStatus
options.description: ReplacementStatus query parameter. Device Replacement status READY-FOR-REPLACEMENT, REPLACEMENT-IN- PROGRESS, REPLACEMENT-SCHEDULED, REPLACED, ERROR, NETWORK_READINESS_REQUESTED, NETWORK_READINESS_FAILED.

options.name: sortBy
options.description: SortBy query parameter. SortBy this field. SortBy is mandatory when order is used.

options.name: sortOrder
options.description: SortOrder query parameter. Order on displayNameASC,DESC.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
